# Phase 1 Pipeline — Databricks Cluster Run

Run this notebook on Databricks cluster. Scripts sourced from workspace path.
For local runs, use `00. MASTER_RUN.R` instead.

```{r setup}
# Databricks workspace path to Codes/ folder
CODES_PATH <- "/Workspace/Users/tajayalath@ua.edu/Drought-indices/files/Codes"
```

```{r packages}
# pysparklyr not on CRAN — install from GitHub if missing
if (!requireNamespace("pysparklyr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("remotes")
  message("Installing pysparklyr from GitHub...")
  remotes::install_github("mlverse/pysparklyr")
}

required_packages <- c(
  "sparklyr", "dbplyr",
  "dplyr", "purrr", "lubridate", "stringr", "tidyr",
  "SPEI",
  "terra", "sf",
  "ecmwfr",
  "rnaturalearth", "rnaturalearthdata",
  "ggplot2", "ggpubr", "colorspace", "tidyterra", "patchwork",
  "here", "modelsummary"
)

missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !sapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  message(sprintf("Installing %d missing package(s): %s",
                  length(missing_packages),
                  paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", ")))
  install.packages(missing_packages, dependencies = TRUE)
} else {
  message("All required packages already installed.")
}
```

```{r run-flags}
# Set TRUE/FALSE to control which steps execute
RUN_SPI        <- TRUE   # Script 01: SPI calculation
RUN_SPEI_T     <- TRUE   # Script 02a: SPEI Thornthwaite
RUN_SPEI_P     <- TRUE   # Script 02b: SPEI Penman-Monteith
RUN_DETECTION  <- TRUE   # Script 03: Drought detection
```

```{r step1-spi}
if (RUN_SPI) {
  message("================================================================")
  message("STEP 1: SPI Calculation")
  message("================================================================")
  source(file.path(CODES_PATH, "01. SPI_Calculation.R"))
}
```

```{r step2a-spei-thornthwaite}
if (RUN_SPEI_T) {
  message("================================================================")
  message("STEP 2a: SPEI Calculation — Thornthwaite PET")
  message("================================================================")
  source(file.path(CODES_PATH, "02a. SPEI_Calculation_Thornthwaite.R"))
}
```

```{r step2b-spei-penman}
if (RUN_SPEI_P) {
  message("================================================================")
  message("STEP 2b: SPEI Calculation — Penman-Monteith PET")
  message("  Requires: PET_data_prep/ steps completed first")
  message("================================================================")
  source(file.path(CODES_PATH, "02b. SPEI_Calculation_Penman.R"))
}
```

```{r step3-detection}
if (RUN_DETECTION) {
  message("================================================================")
  message("STEP 3: Drought Detection — All 45 Configurations")
  message("================================================================")
  source(file.path(CODES_PATH, "03. Drought_Detection.R"))
}
```

```{r pipeline-complete}
message("================================================================")
message("PIPELINE COMPLETE")
message("================================================================")
message("Outputs saved to /Volumes/ or ./Data/:")
if (RUN_SPI)       message("  spi_results.rds")
if (RUN_SPEI_T)    message("  spei_thornthwaite_results.rds")
if (RUN_SPEI_P)    message("  spei_penman_results.rds")
if (RUN_DETECTION) message("  all_drought_events.rds")
if (RUN_DETECTION) message("  drought_summary_yearly.csv")
if (RUN_DETECTION) message("  drought_annual_summary.csv")
```
